out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED NO SOAP PROVIDED IN EMPLOYEE BATHROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI: SOAP PROVIDED TO SINK DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. OBSERVED TWO BOTTLES OF RAID IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CDI: RAID REMOVED FROM KITCHEN DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: OBSERVED THE DISHWASHING MACHINE TO BE AT 0PPM CHLORINE.
violations.corrective_action: PLEASE GET DISHWASHING MACHINE SERVICED SO IT PROVIDES 50-200PPM CHLORINE. CHECK THIS MACHINE REGULARLY. UTILIZE THREE-VAT SINK AND BOTTLED BLEACH TO WASH, RINSE, AND SANITIZE FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES.
